name: JellyFetch
description: Automatically scrapes, orchestrates cloud downloads, and injects them directly into your Jellyfin library. Fully automatic UI install - no manual web file setup required.
overview: A powerful plugin built for Indian users (with 1tamilmv integration) to seamlessly download and organize media.

versions.changelog: v1.0.5.1: Fix browser freeze ('Page Unresponsive') on video player exit by eliminating recursive syncButton microtask loop and adding video player guards.

v1.0.5: Native Jellyfin detail button styling matching default theme, fixed-width progress indicator showing only percentage, zero-MutationObserver event-driven navigation, in-place modal progress view, and persistent progress bar fix.

Fix: Real library deduplication skips dummy strm creation for owned movies. Redesigned Cleanup .strm tool with real-time percentage progress and live activity log box, deselected language removal, and auto-refresh library scan.

Fix: Scraper MissingMethodException cross-version compatibility for Jellyfin 10.9, 10.10, and 12.1+. Multi-language releases of the same movie (e.g. Tamil and Malayalam) are now cleanly merged under the same movie without overwriting or creating duplicate entries.

Patch release: Fixed Seedr connection stalling (MissingMethodException), fixed post-download page rendering (metadata race condition), fixed background download hijacking user session, fixed Stop button label. Added automatic web UI installation - plugin now auto-patches index.html on startup, no manual dist.tar.gz required.
